pr_title: Add support for VERSION field type in SQL and EQL
pr_comment: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

> There seems to be a problem with queries like select `first(version::string::version) from apps` though.

The reason for this error is that StreamOutput has no writer defined for Version type. The blocker for fixing it is that Version class is in x-pack, so I cannot reference it from inside Server module. Unfortunately I don't see a simple solution for this, apart from moving Version implementation to Server module, with all the implications on licensing. 
In my opinion, a fix with this impact (changes to multiple modules, licensing implications) is not justified by the uncommon use case, unless there is some request from the user base. My suggestion is to leave it as it is for now and track it with a new issue.

Had to revert due to the following:


The problem seems to be related to how Version objects are translated to strings to be serialized, so it should be deterministic, but strangely it's not (before merging the build was green and I didn't notice this error before during the tests)

review_comment: I don't see the usefulness of this set of data. Can you explain, please?

It was an attempt to randomize the test dataset as much as possible, adding valid and invalid version values outside of the range of the test queries so that the tests are still predictable. Eg. test that random values that do not match the test criteria are not returned by mistake.
I think you need to look at `testUnsignedLongVersionCompatibility` as a test example for `version`. What do you think @bpintea?
